title: opencode-recall Configuration
description: Configuration file for the opencode-recall plugin

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocompletion

database.description: OpenCode history and recall sidecar database paths

sources.description: Named read-only source databases. Both runtimes may share each source's dedicated sidecar. Overrides path/indexPath.

id.description: Stable source name used in qualified cursors.

indexPath.description: Dedicated sidecar; defaults to a hash of the canonical source path.

path.description: OpenCode SQLite session database. Opened read-only by recall.

indexPath.description: Recall sidecar embedding index. Defaults to opencode-recall-<source-path-hash>.db in the OpenCode data directory. Safe to delete and rebuild.

legacyPath.description: Deprecated: use sources. Resolved as a separate source named legacy with its own index.

model.description: Ollama embedding model. Try mxbai-embed-large for higher quality.
